answer.reason: The BLS QCEW 2024 Q4 statewide Missouri private-sector covered employment value for NAICS 23 Construction is 146,827 covered jobs; the 164,268 figure is not the QCEW private covered-jobs value.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Missouri, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 164,268 covered jobs
B. 146,827 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Missouri statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/29000.csv)
